RESULT_EXPIRED: The retained canonical result expired. Start a new authorized attempt.
RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: A contributor exhausted its resource allowance. Retry with prepared capacity or a shorter conversation.
AUTHORIZATION_DENIED: A contributor declined authorization for this request.
EXECUTION_FAILED: Partition peer declined or failed request
OUTPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A contributor exceeded the answer length allowance. The attempt failed; its partial answer is incomplete.
GENERATION_OUTPUT_INVALID: A contributor did not produce a valid final answer. The attempt failed; its partial answer is incomplete.
CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE: A contributor has no available prepared capacity for this attempt. Select available capacity and retry.
CAPACITY_QUEUE_FULL: Prepared capacity for this route is busy and its queue is full. The attempt was not run; retry later.
CAPACITY_QUEUE_TIMEOUT: No prepared capacity for this route became free before this attempt's queue limit or permission window ended. The attempt was not run; retry starts a new attempt.
CONNECTION_LOST: A contributor disconnected. The attempt was interrupted; remote cleanup is not confirmed.
REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The contributor request timed out. Remote completion and cleanup are not confirmed.
CLEANUP_FAILED: Partition attempt settlement failed. Contributor cleanup is not confirmed; its capacity remains unavailable.
ANSWER_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: Response timed out. Retry starts a new attempt.
WORKLOAD_OUTSIDE_ENVELOPE: This route does not support a request of this prompt length, answer length or number of concurrent requests. Nothing was sent to its contributors.
